feed_summary: Unauthorized parties have gained access to the names, addresses, and personal identification numbers of about 8.8 million people, living and dead, in Denmark's national population register, the country's digitalization ministry said on October 5. title: Denmark Says Attackers Accessed CPR Data for 8.8 Million People via Company Account
